scope: Android-independent Java Core compilation and JVM unit tests, including Ed25519 model-publisher signature verification, publisher-before-staging pipeline order, Broker-private resumable artifact staging, and serialized preflight/load/commit model activation rules. The stager verifies exact HTTP range semantics and SHA-256, enforces byte/free-space limits, rejects symlink paths, resumes partial files, and promotes verified bytes atomically. Activation validates active runtime compatibility, requires stage and runtime-load receipts before changing the active pointer, blocks switching across active work or a recent unmatched plan reservation, and leaves the old pointer intact on loader failure. It stages only model weights; tokenizer/template assets, Android build, Binder/device integration and device inference are not covered.
defectsFoundAndFixed: ModelProfile and RuntimeManifest rejected the actual Zema schema ID article-preparation@1/input-v1.
Engine.claim loaded the work row's profile pin but constructed Ticket from a runs-only row, dropping the model profile identity.
PlatformStore lacked the HashMap import required by model-profile and recoverable-state code.
Engine.submitPinned used a missing error-code overload for its single-row query.
Profile activation now waits for an exact loaded-runtime receipt and does not replace a runtime model used by an active or recently reserved Zema plan.

implementation: TrustedModelPublisherVerifier binds Ed25519 public keys to exact publisher ID and key ID, enforces key revocation, and verifies canonical signed manifest bytes.
TrustedModelArtifactPipeline checks publisher signature before invoking the Broker-owned staged-artifact verifier and requires a digest receipt.
testCases: modified manifest, unknown publisher/key, revoked key and malformed public key rejected
invalid signature stops before staged artifact access
newModelTrustCoverage.remaining: No production publisher keyset is configured; actual artifact bytes/license/storage staging and Android installer wiring remain unimplemented.

implementation: ResumableModelArtifactStager downloads into Broker-private hash-addressed storage, resumes only from the exact partial offset, checks response ranges/content length and bounded byte counts, verifies the complete SHA-256, and atomically promotes the artifact.
Disk-space reserve and maximum artifact size are enforced; symlink paths and unsafe hash-derived paths are rejected; cached artifacts are reverified.
testCases: interrupted transfer resumes and verified artifact is atomically promoted and reverified from cache
incorrect range and response body overrun are rejected
insufficient disk space fails before contacting the source
newArtifactStagingCoverage.remaining: Only weights are modeled. The Android source coordinator now sequences publisher verification, staging, Local AI read-only descriptor handoff, load receipt/status validation, and active-pointer commit, with rollback attempt if a later commit fails. Production publisher trust, provider source, tokenizer/template staging, licensing receipts, API/catalog entry point, native Android build, and device inference remain unimplemented or unverified.

implementation: PlatformStore performs profile/runtime compatibility and conflicting-work preflight before external verification, then rechecks before atomically committing the active profile.
TrustedModelArtifactPipeline sequences publisher signature verification, verified staging, and runtime load; both staging and load receipts are required.

Broker ModelProfileActivationCoordinator hands the staged weight file to the separate Local AI service over a read-only ParcelFileDescriptor, checks the runtime load receipt/status, serializes activation against Zema inference, and attempts to reload the prior model if commit fails after runtime load.
testCases: active old plan pin blocks model switch while its work runs or reservation remains fresh
runtime load failure keeps old profile active
valid signature and staging receipt are required before runtime load
newActivationCoverage.remaining: The coordinator is implemented as Android source but is not yet exposed through a user-facing model catalog or connected to production artifact transport and publisher trust configuration. Only weights are staged; tokenizer/template staging and license receipts are absent. Android APK/AIDL build, instrumentation, production trust keyset and source adapter, and device load/inference remain unverified.
